MQTT, Azure IoT Operations and cloud destinations
Outages, operations, testing, pilot and expansion

takeaways: Scope the first PLC connection around one production question, such as explaining short stops, and let OT keep authority over machine access, recovery and approval of every new data path.
Telemetry must never become part of the control loop or safety functions: the filler has to keep running when Azure, the collector or the network link is unavailable.
Prove each layer with evidence, from OPC UA certificates and a written collection budget to MQTT delivery, outage buffering and a narrow pilot, before expanding access to more equipment.
hook: Connecting PLCs to Azure promises better production insight, but even read-only access can add controller load and open network paths into a live plant. This episode is for OT engineers, IT architects and plant managers who need machine data without making production depend on the cloud. You will learn architecture patterns for OT-IT convergence, from network zones and OPC UA security to MQTT, Azure IoT Operations and a safe pilot.
